seedLockAttempt.harness: research script outside the repo: every sourced option + sourcedSheetOrder, lethal false, k3 presses from build(winner.knobs) placed by cumulative real ms (frame-rounded, it matches minus-toys-plan.mjs schedule() on 517/517 rows at three epochs); schedule epoch swept 2514 +/- 150 ms in frame steps; scored like twin-analyze (conflict / hit / miss per 10 s cycle) against a 300-seed random control on the same grid
seedLockAttempt.predeclaredLockRule: one window seed with 0 conflicts and >= 4 hits, strictly better than the other window seeds, matched by < 5% of control seeds

full02.multipleComparison: the best of 16 window seeds would match that by chance about 31% of the time (1 - 0.977^16)
full02.note: every seed reproduces much of the phone's Bonnie/Chica alternation (control best hits 7-18), so encounter identity per cycle separates seeds weakly
